premise_review: Every4319B original and complete organized source independently read. Utf8Payload retains bytes:Array UInt8,text:String and exact text.toUTF8.data=bytes. lengthPrefixDigits is little-endian width-limited, byteDigitsMSB is most-significant-first eight digits, and payloadDigitsMSB preserves byte order.

BitDocument retains full Bool list and both deriving instances; digitByte maps false/true to48/49 and serialize appends exactly one final LF10. All width/byte length and terminal-LF simp proofs remain exact. This does not supply a file operation, runtime parser or theorem that arbitrary bytes are valid UTF8.

RepresentableLength is the actual strict byteLength<2^prefixWidth bound with exact Decidable instance. EncodeDecodeRelation retains BOTH canonical encoding equality and representability. DecodeWitness keeps prefixWidth,explicitMaximum,document,payload,bytes.size<=maximum and exact relation fields. Both exact projection/congruence proofs preserve every parameter.

Prefix width0 permits only representable byteLength0; encoding itself exists without that witness and may truncate high length bits. No dropped maximum/encoding/representability hypothesis, UTF8 decoder, successful rejection test, total inverse or actual resource enforcement is inferred.
